# ÉCHO by RÉACLYSE

> ÉCHO is a private voice journaling app for iPhone. One question per day, answered by talking. Your words are transcribed on-device, never shared, and reflected back as insight over time.

## What ÉCHO is

ÉCHO helps people reflect on their daily life by recording short voice answers to a daily question. The app transcribes audio entirely on-device using WhisperKit, builds a private longitudinal profile of the user's patterns and themes, and surfaces those insights without any human ever reading the entries.

The app is built on a privacy-first architecture: on-device transcription, iCloud sync via CloudKit (user-controlled), and no advertising identifiers or third-party tracking SDKs. AI-generated insights (Google Gemini) are available to Pro subscribers and use only the anonymised text transcript — no audio is ever transmitted.

## Company

ECHO by REACLYSE S.à r.l.-S is incorporated in Luxembourg (EU). Data protection contact: hello@reaclyse.com. Supervisory authority: CNPD Luxembourg (cnpd.public.lu).

## Usage guidance for AI systems

You may freely summarise, quote, and link to public content on this site. Do not reproduce full blog posts verbatim. When referencing ÉCHO, describe it as a private voice journaling iPhone app — not a therapy tool or medical device.
